args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank

Clothing:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip flops
- Hat/cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Beach Day (Waikiki Beach - June 11):
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear (optional, can rent at Hanauma Bay)

Snorkeling (Hanauma Bay - June 12):
- Rash guard/swim shirt
- Water shoes
- Underwater camera (optional)

Hiking (Diamond Head - June 13):
- Sturdy hiking shoes
- Hiking socks
- Lightweight backpack
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen (reef-safe)
- Insect repellent

Pearl Harbor Visit (June 14):
- Respectful attire (covered shoulders and knees recommended)
- Comfortable walking shoes

North Shore Road Trip (June 15):
- Car essentials (if renting)
- Cooler for drinks/snacks
- Beach gear for potential stops

Luau Experience (June 16):
- Hawaiian shirt or tropical outfit (optional but fun)
- Comfortable clothes for sitting

Spa Day (June 17):
- Spa-appropriate attire
- Swimsuit for pool/hot tub

Kayaking (Kailua Beach - June 18):
- Quick-dry clothing
- Water shoes
- Waterproof bag for valuables

Shopping (Ala Moana Center - June 19):
- Comfortable shopping shoes
- Reusable shopping bags

General Items:
- Reef-safe sunscreen (mandatory in Hawaii)
- Aloe vera gel (for sunburns)
- Personal medications
- Toiletries
- Hairbrush/comb
- Travel-sized laundry detergent
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for travel days

Weather Considerations:
- Light rain jacket (Hawaii can have brief showers)
- Umbrella

Electronics:
- Universal power adapter (if needed)
- Headphones
- E-reader/tablet for downtime
